sources.title: Agent handoff and custom CLI boundary
sources.locator: Context handoff; Custom Harness; Antigravity sections
sources.finding: A handoff creates a new conversation from a bounded transcript/output snapshot. Custom shell-capable commands run as the service user and are explicitly not a security sandbox. Antigravity requires separately installed agy.

sources.title: Read-only Git content source
sources.finding: The backend runs bounded Git status and text diff commands, including staged diff, with external diff helpers/hooks disabled.

sources.title: Actual Git patch display
sources.finding: The Git panel fetches each file's diff body and renders escaped patch lines in a pre block with added/removed styling.
